I have worked writing clean and responsive codes, performing continuous integration, and covering backend developer roles with Node.js and SQL. I have led teams having empathy, exercising motivation to partners, and setting plans and goals together.

Experience.Title: Experience

Experience.Jobs.Title: Software Development Engineer 1
Description: Integrated ICICI Elevate and Care Ultimate health insurance plans into the quote and proposal engine, ensuring complete compliance with underwriting logic and business rules.
Engineered the proposal generation and premium breakdown modules with dynamic add-on handling, which supported more than 20 complex add-on combinations and improved modularity.
Built region-wise underwriting rules (Delhi NCR, Gautam Buddha Nagar, etc.) involving mandatory addons, zone-based exclusions, and max-age filters, reducing manual errors by 80%.
Revamped the bucketing and sorting logic in quote APIs to dynamically prioritize insurers and plans based on backend configurations, improving user quote relevance.
Optimized addon eligibility mapping using MongoDB aggregation and indexing, resulting in a 35% speed improvement for quote generation.
Collaborated across product and QA teams to finalize premium payload design, covering sum insured limits, CIBIL discounts, business types, and tenure validation.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Fullstack Developer
Description: Spearheaded the frontend development efforts for the TankhaPay project using Angular, resulting in user-friendly and responsive interfaces that significantly improved the application's overall user experience.
Integrated frontend components, optimizing performance and maintainability, and directly contributed to the successful securing of $2.7 million in funding from Japanese investors.

Demonstrated expertise in designing, developing, and maintaining robust REST APIs utilizing Node.js and Express, while also contributing to the optimization of PostgreSQL functions to reduce server load, resulting in improved application performance and efficiency.
Implemented various features in the Tankhapay web application including authentication, data binding, and responsive design.

Developed Excel download feature for reports, made multiple salary slips in single PDF download feature, and optimized application performance. This module contributed to securing over 8 clients and generating revenue exceeding 1 crore.
